content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [product_name] [version_no] and need an analog output, but I can't locate the appropriate module. Is it possible to connect a module from another version to [product_name] [version_no]?
No. All expansion modules with the [article_no] identifier are designed only for [product_name] [version_no], and won't work with older [product_name] modules.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face compatibility issues when looking for analog output modules for [product_name] [version_no]. Only specific expansion modules work with this version, and the lack of clarity leads to confusion when choosing compatible components for system expansion.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect analog output expansion modules to be available and work with [product_name] [version_no], or at a minimum, for compatibility details to be clearly communicated.
